description: The Advanced Technology Microwave Sounder (ATMS) for QuickSounder (ATMS serial number 301), a 22-channel cross-track microwave sounder. The curves are the pre-launch channel spectral response functions of the NASA/GSFC public release for the primary (PRI) and redundant (RED) local oscillators, converted from frequency to wavelength.
facility_description: QuickSounder, a NEON-1 series space mission carrying an ATMS (NASA/GSFC release announcement in the SRF zip).

notes: Per the release announcement in the zip: measured by Northrop Grumman at receiver-subsystem level (flight antenna excluded) at about +20 C shelf temperature, nominal voltage, corrected to vacuum; all frequencies in RF; amplitudes normalised to 0 dB peak; a noise-floor correction was applied; PRI = primary (A-side) LO, RED = redundant (B-side) LO; channels 1-2 are direct-detect. Response converted to linear and scaled to peak 1; wavelength = c/nu. DetectorType energy is assumed. QuickSounder ch18_RED peaks at +0.08 dB in the file.
